name: arcade-ui-dev
description: Agent instructions for building and extending the Arcade-UI 16-bit React component library. Use when scaffolding components, editing CSS Modules, or publishing Arcade-UI.

cssArchitecture.typography: Use --arcade-font-display (Press Start 2P) for controls and --arcade-font-body (VT323) for supporting copy.
cssArchitecture.antiAliasing: Force image-rendering: pixelated; -webkit-font-smoothing: none; font-smooth: never on painted surfaces.
cssArchitecture.borders: Never use CSS border. Build pixel edges and solid drop-shadows with box-shadow layers or the --arcade-pixel-border / --arcade-drop-shadow variables.
cssArchitecture.interaction: Active states translate down the Y-axis and collapse the drop-shadow to simulate an arcade button press. Use steps() timing, not easing curves.

workflow: Run pnpm scaffold ComponentName (Ponytail) instead of inventing a new folder shape.
Keep public props in the component file and re-export types from src/index.ts.
Import styles from the sibling *.module.css file only. Do not add Tailwind or utility frameworks.
Add a Storybook story with autodocs, using the Arcade-UI/{Name} title.
Verify the arcade press motion and pixel edges before finishing.
doNot: Do not use Tailwind, CSS-in-JS, or utility class frameworks.
Do not emit CSS border, border-radius curves, or blur shadows.
Do not bundle react or react-dom. They are peer dependencies.
Do not export files from src/ outside the barrel.
